simple.meaning: חֶמְלָה (chemlâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “commiseration.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Genesis, Isaiah, beginning at Genesis 19:16. Its contexts include family line, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶמְלָה (H2551).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֶמְלָה (chemlâh) / H2551 is traced through Genesis 19:16, Isaiah 63:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.
